integrity: The infinite-index conclusion is proved by arbitrary finite axis tests; no finite experiment is used as evidence for the infinite theorem.
limitations: Exact finite equality is asserted for octahedral factors; for merely \(\delta\)-average rough factors only the lower bound \(\delta m^{-1/p}\) is proved.
The literature comparison cannot exclude unindexed or inaccessible equivalent statements.
title: Sharp average-roughness law for finite and infinite \(\ell_p\)-sums
